what: When the head of a card group touches the bottom edge of the screen, the cards rise one after another from 60px below and transparent over .5s power3.out at .5s intervals, and when the group leaves the screen (passing off the top or going back down) they sink back along the same path in reverse — they rise again every time they re-enter. For lists that are revisited while scrolling up and down, such as event · News card grids

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Card to float up (child) — if none, all direct children
options.y: Rise distance, default 60 (px) — with unit, like 3vw
options.actions: toggleActions, default play reverse play reverse — for a single play, use play none none none

from.where: index.html event · program cards (.AnmFadeInBtm on every .CardBox — original common.js: fromTo opacity 0 · y 60 → .5s power3.out stagger .5, start top 100%, toggleActions play reverse play reverse)
